To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the use of context information in a language modeling manner improves topic coherence and (2) incorporating distributional prior into topic models improves generalization and interpretability.

(1) iDocNADE is the best generative topic model in terms of generalizability, interpretability, and applicability on long texts; and (2) iDocNADECe is the best generatve topic model in terms generalizability, interpretable, and applicability in terms of retrieval on short texts.

(1) iDocNADE outperforms state of the art topic models in terms generalization, interpret-ability and applicability on long text; (2) iDocNAADE outperforms state-of-the-art topic models in terms interpretation and generalization on short text and is comparable on applicability; (3) DocNADEe outperforms state the art topic models on short text in terms of generaliz-ation, interpretability, and applicability.

the following contributions: (1) We propose a novel neural topic model, iDocNADE, which is based on a language modeling approach, i.e. it exploits the full context information of a word in a document.

iDocNADE is a good model for general topic modeling tasks on long texts, while DocNADEe performs better on short text classification tasks.
the iDocNADE model outperforms all the other models in terms of all the evaluation metrics on both long and short texts.
the proposed models are able to capture more interpretable topics and perform well on both long text and short text datasets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed models can be applied on a wide range of text datasets and outperform state of art generative topic model methods.
the proposed models are able to capture the context of words in documents and can be used in a wide range of NLP tasks.
we have proposed two simple and effective extensions to neural autoregressive models, namely iDocNADE and iDocNADee.
The main takeaway from our work is that
incorporating context information around words into topic models is crucial for improving their performance, while the use of distributional prior is beneficial for short texts.
the proposed neural autoregressive models can be extended with external information to improve their performance and can be used for a variety of tasks, such as topic retrieval and classification.
the context information and external knowledge can help to overcome the challenges of topic models in long text as well as in short text.
